name: Neemo StakingManagerL1 unauthenticated weETH sweep 12 seconds after upgrade
summary: The StakingManagerL1 implementation installed on the UUPS proxy 0x54cd2346 in the previous block added three new external selectors, and one of them, 0x03b79c24(address), transfers the proxy's entire weETH balance to a caller-supplied address with no role or owner check. The previous implementation did not expose that selector, so the upgrade itself introduced an unauthenticated sweep of the staking manager's whole weETH reserve; a searcher called it 12 seconds later from transaction index 0 of the next block and sold the proceeds into the weETH/WETH Uniswap V3 pool.
notes: The seventh and last pre-exploit EIP-1967 Upgraded event on the proxy, emitted by the upgrader's upgradeToAndCall(0xbc4b1d58...), selected the defect-bearing implementation one block before the exploit.

The proxy's weETH balance was 106.929468097270451433 at the end of block 22855568 and zero at the end of block 22855569; the single anchor transaction moved the whole balance, so the campaign is one transaction and there is nothing left to drain. Valued at the DefiLlama weETH price four minutes before the exploit. The figure is corroborated by realised proceeds: the attacker sold the weETH into the weETH/WETH Uniswap V3 pool 0x202a6012894ae5c288ea824cbc8a9bfb26a49b93 for 114.534059890882021484 WETH, unwrapped it and forwarded the ETH to the sender EOA, which is 287,182.70 USD at the contemporaneous WETH price - 0.04 percent above the marked value, so the sale did not materially move the price and no realised-proceeds adjustment is needed. The seed row's 285,700 USD figure was a reported estimate.

The exploited implementation 0xbc4b1d58b28c497b7afda6fb90fe1471fa0672cc is not verified on Etherscan, so the sweeping function has no published name; it is identified by selector 0x03b79c24(address) and its behaviour was established by fork reproduction and by diffing its selector table against the verified previous implementation.

protocol.slug stays unverified-54cd to match the seed inventory row, but this review identified the affected system: the proxy's previous implementation 0x9b1f03796ca66240a8a3f159b836c69f951261c9 is verified as neemo's StakingManagerL1 and the proxy's weETH() getter matches, so protocol.name has been corrected from unverified_0x54Cd2346.
